"""Handcrafted tricky cases with full verification."""
import copy, json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/vendor')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
import verify
from fractions import Fraction
from run_tests import run_candidate, get_preds_thr
from gen import brute

def W(flow=0, ready=0, exp=10, T=1000, C=10, draw=0, prio=1, feat=None):
    return [flow, ready, exp, T, C, draw, prio, feat or [[0, 0]] * 9]

def case(**kw):
    c = {'model': 'cnn', 'class_values': [1]*7, 'stats': [10, 10, 75], 'bucket': [2, 2],
         'slots': [[0, 2, 0], [5, 2, 0], [10, 2, 0]], 'flows': [[1, 3, -1, 0]], 'groups': [],
         'windows': [W() for _ in range(3)]}
    c.update(kw)
    return c

cases = []
# 1. token saturation: big refill discarded above B
cases.append(case(bucket=[1, 1], slots=[[0, 0, 0], [1, 5, 0], [2, 5, 100], [3, 5, 0]],
    flows=[[1, 3, -1, 0]], windows=[W(exp=10), W(exp=10), W(exp=10)]))
# 2. exact token budget insufficient due to saturation
cases.append(case(bucket=[1, 0], slots=[[0, 5, 0], [1, 5, 5], [2, 5, 5]],
    flows=[[3, 3, -1, 0]], windows=[W(exp=10) for _ in range(3)]))
# 3. group ancestor ceilings: chain g0<-g1<-g2, flow on g2 must respect all
cases.append(case(groups=[[-1, 1], [0, 2], [1, 5]], flows=[[1, 1, 2, 3], [1, 1, 2, 4], [1, 1, 1, 5]],
    windows=[W(flow=0, exp=10), W(flow=1, exp=10), W(flow=2, exp=10)]))
# 4. gate boundary: draw == threshold-1 passes, draw == threshold fails
cases.append(case(stats=[1, 1, 75], windows=[W(draw=4853), W(draw=4854)]))
# 5. windows before ready / after expires
cases.append(case(slots=[[0, 5, 0], [5, 5, 0], [10, 5, 0]],
    windows=[W(ready=6, exp=10), W(ready=0, exp=4), W(ready=0, exp=10)]))
# 6. flow ceiling binding over target
cases.append(case(flows=[[1, 1, -1, 2]], windows=[W(exp=10), W(exp=10), W(exp=10)]))
# 7. zero-capacity slots only -> nothing selectable
cases.append(case(slots=[[0, 0, 0], [5, 0, 0]], windows=[W(exp=10)]))
# 8. no windows
cases.append(case(windows=[]))
# 9. multi-flow coverage interplay (2 flows share slots)
cases.append(case(flows=[[2, 2, -1, 0], [1, 1, -1, 1]],
    windows=[W(flow=0, exp=10), W(flow=0, exp=10), W(flow=1, exp=10)]))
# 10. deep group tree with unattached groups
cases.append(case(groups=[[1, 1], [-1, 3], [0, 2], [-1, 0]],
    flows=[[1, 1, 0, 1], [1, 1, 2, 2]], windows=[W(flow=0, exp=10), W(flow=1, exp=10)]))
# 11. huge value span and W scaling: big priorities
cases.append(case(class_values=[1, 1000, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1], flows=[[1, 3, -1, 0]],
    windows=[W(prio=1000), W(prio=1), W(prio=500)]))
# 12. equal values -> ties
cases.append(case(flows=[[1, 3, -1, 0]], windows=[W(exp=10), W(exp=10), W(exp=10)]))
# 13. draw=65535 with threshold 65535 style stats
cases.append(case(stats=[1, 1, 1], windows=[W(draw=65535), W(draw=0)]))
# 14. only late slots (age>0)
cases.append(case(slots=[[7, 2, 0], [9, 2, 0]], windows=[W(ready=0, exp=10), W(ready=0, exp=8)]))
# 15. group ceiling 0 blocks flows attached there
cases.append(case(groups=[[2, 0], [2, 2], [-1, 3]], flows=[[1, 1, 0, 0], [1, 1, 1, 1]],
    windows=[W(flow=0, exp=10), W(flow=1, exp=10)]))

fails = 0
for i, c in enumerate(cases):
    req = {'version': 3, 'cases': [c]}
    resp = run_candidate(req)
    errs = verify.check(req, resp)
    if errs:
        fails += 1
        print(f'edge {i}: VERIFY FAIL {errs[:6]}')
        continue
    # brute-force objective comparison
    cc = copy.deepcopy(c)
    preds, thr = get_preds_thr(cc)
    cc['preds'], cc['thr'] = preds, thr
    best = brute(cc)
    res = resp['results'][0]
    got = (Fraction(*res['ratio']), res['utility'], -res['age'])
    if best is None or got != best:
        fails += 1
        print(f'edge {i}: BRUTE MISMATCH got {got} best {best}')
    else:
        print(f'edge {i}: ok r={res["ratio"]} U={res["utility"]} A={res["age"]} cut={"yes" if res["cut"] is not None else "null"}')
print(json.dumps({'failures': fails}))
sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)
EOF
